items.text: Unscrew all windows and make sure they open, close, stay open and lock.
items.priceBasis: Est. 90 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $54. Roughly 8-10 windows at ~10 min each: back out the screws, free the sash, test open/close/stay open/lock. Your near-identical past job "Remove screws on all windows and make them open, stay open, close and lock" ran $50 labor, so this is in line.
Est. 35 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $21. Three screens at ~10 min each to pull and fit, plus a few minutes to check which ones actually need it.

items.text: Remove trip hazard between kitchen and hallway — exposed metal transition strip at the floor threshold.
items.priceBasis: Est. 40 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $24. Pry out the old metal track, scrape the old adhesive off the subfloor, cut a new transition strip to the doorway width and fasten it. Material $25 for one transition strip, matching your usual $25 material figure.
